content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [article_no] version without display and I can't establish communication with my software. What should I do?
Which cable are you using? What is your software [version_no]?
You can download the manual here: [url] Check starting from page 237 and onwards.

If I recall correctly: 1) Connect the [product_name] cable to your PC and to the device. 2) Cycle the power (when the cable is connected, the device starts in STOP mode after powering on). 3) Choose your hardware ([article_no]) in [product_name] software. 4) Download the program. If the device will not enter Transfer mode or you've selected the wrong hardware model in [product_name] software, you will be unable to download. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face issues communicating between a [product_name] device without display and the relevant configuration software. Problems arise from selecting the correct hardware version and following the connection procedure, indicating confusion with user experience and insufficient guidance for models lacking display.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy connection process between hardware and configuration software, with clear instructions for communication setup, especially for devices that do not have a display.
